== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Soulsmithing is a highly respected and distinguished craft involving the manipulation of spiritual essence. Practitioners, known as [[Soulsmiths]], work with the components of spirits to forge weapons, create various constructs, and transplant [[binding|bindings]] from [[Remnants]] into [[sacred artists]]. The craft requires a dedicated commitment to experimentation, an exceptional memory, and the ability to distinguish between subtle differences in spiritual structures. A successful [[Soulsmith]] must be able to identify which parts of a [[Remnant]] are useful and which are waste, as making incorrect assumptions can ruin the work. Training for this profession is a multi-year process that involves mastering core skills such as memorizing basic [[scripts]], practicing [[Forging]] to create functional shells around [[binding|bindings]], and learning to use a foundry. While these skills do not directly assist in combat, [[Soulsmiths]] are valuable assets to clans and sects, often serving as primary income earners for families. To assist in their analytical work, [[Soulsmiths]] often create drudges—specialized constructs that serve as mobile toolboxes, assistants, and encyclopedias capable of scanning [[Remnants]] for power concentrations. The process often utilizes [[soulfire]], which is distilled aura used to refine physical vessels and remove impurities. Specialized tools are also central to the craft; hammers are used not just for physical shaping, but to inject a smith's willpower and intention into an object. For advanced work involving the [[Authority|authority]] of higher-tier existences, [[Soulsmiths]] may utilize a [[Soulforge]]. The art can range from the creation of practical items to the production of exquisite, beautiful works of art and complex sacred instruments. Knowledge can be passed down through [[dream tablets]], which are lifelong repositories of a smith's expertise designed for an heir.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Lindon]] intends to practice the skill of Soulsmithing and possesses the necessary supplies for the craft. This discipline involves utilizing hammers to crack open a [[Remnant]]'s carapace or batter [[dead matter]] into its proper place. While [[Archlord]] artifacts represent the absolute peak of traditional Soulsmithing, practitioners must approach the highest levels of the skill with extreme care because of the high price required for success.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The highest level of [[Soulsmithing]] must be approached with care due to the high price of success.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
